_comment_family: The other end of the same family, and the reason both packs declare
a full name instead of 'Telegraf': the two files share name ID 1, so
the family alone names neither of them. See the note in
telegraf-ultralight.json, which this pack is the other half of.
Weight 800 rather than 700, because that is what the cut is called
and what the file is: asking for 700 invites a browser to synthesise
the difference on top of a face that already has it.
_comment_css: Not declared in styles.css: this face arrived with a channel and is
registered from this JSON, which is the route content/README.md
describes. Nothing has to be added to the stylesheet for it.
_comment_local: What the machine may already know the face by, tried after the file.
The first is the PostScript name and is also what the installer
registers the face under; the second is the Windows full name. Both
name this one cut rather than the family, so a machine answering to
either is answering with this file. 'Telegraf' on its own is
deliberately absent: it is the name the UltraLight answers to as
